description: session.rs:272-276: the comment explains that STARTTLS is not advertised because it's not yet implemented. However it does not explain that even when TLS is configured (cert+key set), STARTTLS is still suppressed. A contributor who sees TLS configured and adds STARTTLS to the EHLO response will break delivery with STARTTLS-enforcing MTAs (they'll negotiate STARTTLS, get 454, and fail). The comment should say: 'even when TLS is configured, do not advertise STARTTLS until the upgrade path is implemented (stoa-ryw.3)'.
title: EHLO STARTTLS non-advertisement not explained for the TLS-configured case
